description: Opens a watch on a need for the organisation of the token: constraints and software by id or name (any process). CATEGORY follows a process. Returns the watch, initially not_computed; public rules produce a challenger and switch brief. Alerts arrive on following calls; unknown constraints stay uninterpreted. The FREE plan follows one active watch per organisation. Error codes beyond the free watch: free_watch_used (no paid plan; destination = Stripe Checkout), plan_ending (the paid plan is stopped: no new paid watch; destination = the Plan page /my/plan), in _meta["ai.hodds/error"]. Price: search is free; 1 watched solution free, then €0.50 per watched solution per month, €2 monthly minimum (excl. VAT); a 409 with destination is resolved by a person who opens that URL. Needs an organisation token (Authorization: Bearer hodds_...); without it the tool returns the error token_required.

alert_budget.description: Alerts per calendar month (1-20, default 5); beyond, one DIGEST per day.

environment.description: Free description of the environment (not stored).

current_choice.description: Active catalogue id; any process accepted.

current_choice_name.description: Free name instead of id; exact unique matches resolve, others stay unlinked.

level.description: NEED (default when need is given) or CATEGORY (process required, no need).

need.description: The need in natural language, English or French (absent for a CATEGORY watch).

process.description: Process id (from list_processes); deduced from the need when absent.

name: watch_need

outputSchema.description: A watched need as returned by watch_need, get_watch, set_current_choice and POST/GET/PATCH /api/watches[/{id}]. Self-contained: the alert object is inlined (same shape as hodds-alert.schema.json).

alerts.description: The 50 most recent alerts, unacknowledged first (200 with all=true).

code.description: CHALLENGER_STRENGTHENED is reserved and never emitted in 0.3.0.

journal_ref.description: seq of the journal line that triggered the alert, or initial, choice:<instant>, rules, digest:<day>.

reason.description: Template sentence naming the changed fact, its old and new value, the day and the source.

rules_version.description: Identifier of the public rules that computed this value, e.g. ranking-2026-10 (see /rules/).

baseline_request_id.description: request_id of the search that deduced process at opening; null when process was given.

founder_link.description: Declared link between the HODDS founder and the solution. Never affects the challenger.

hodds_status.description: Shown as "Approved by HODDS" or "Not yet approved by HODDS". Never a criterion.

rules_version.description: Identifier of the public rules that computed this value, e.g. ranking-2026-10 (see /rules/).

switch_brief.description: Switch brief: deterministic template built from record fields (no language model).

facts.description: Informative facts compared side by side; never criteria. current is null when the watch has no current choice.

duplicate.description: Only on opening: true when an identical active watch already existed and is returned.

need.description: The need in natural language; absent or null for a CATEGORY watch.

pending.description: Delivery on the next call: alerts that wait for this organisation. Absent when there is nothing to deliver. Only ack_alerts empties it.

summary.description: One sentence in English, or in French when the request was in French.

plan.description: Plan of the organisation when the watch was opened (FREE in this version).

rules_version.description: Identifier of the public rules that computed this value, e.g. ranking-2026-10 (see /rules/).

summary.description: One sentence in English, or in French when the request was in French.

outputSchema.title: HODDS watch (0.3.0)

title: Watch a need
